_comment: The evolution rules the game runs. The C holds none: each table starts empty and the build writes these; a key or a list left out means that rule does not exist. evolutionTiming: hours (of the partner's evoTimer) before each level looks for an evolution, the Ultimate's second wait, the Mega wait, and the Rookie fallback (a Rookie with no candidate becomes `target` after `afterHours`). evolutionFresh: a Baby I becomes this Baby II (at most 8). evolutionUltimate: an Ultimate that evolves again into `to` when its requirements score 3 (at most 8). evolutionSpecial: virus = the virus bar value that forces `target` (not for the two species in notFor); championCheck = the level and evoTimer hour that run the praise rules; scold = the level, and the discipline and happiness before a scolding, that arm the scold flag. evolutionRules (at most 10, 4 species and 4 conditions each): `mode` wake (after waking) or praise (after praise or scolding), `chance` percent (one roll shared by all rules, default 100), `from` the species (leave out for any), `level`, `when` [stat, ==|>=, number] with stat discipline, happiness, tiredness, battles, defense, evoTimer, screen, scoldFlag; the last rule that matches wins. clearsScoldFlag consumes the flag. evolutionItemRules (at most 4): an item past the original evolution items that forces `target` on a partner of `partnerLevel`. evolutionFormula: what happens when a partner evolves and the score that picks its next species. stat.gainDiv / averageDiv: a stat at or above the target's value grows by a part of it (the value / gainDiv), below it meets it halfway (/ averageDiv); lifetime.ultimate / mega: hours added on reaching an Ultimate or a Mega; reset.*: 1 = the weight, care mistakes or battles are reset; scale.*: the species whose evolution scales the base stats by a percent (the target's brains value / percentDiv) and the one that gets its backed-up stats back (restoreFrom / restoreDiv); learn.moveBase[element]: the first technique slot an element teaches on evolving (window: how many slots it picks from); score.*: the points and the tolerance of the requirement score (weightTolerance, pointCareMistakes, pointWeight, pointStats, pointBonus, hpMpDiv, raisedBonus) and passPoints, the points a species needs to be a candidate.

evolutionRules.note: Koromon, Tokomon, Tsunomon, Tanemon on screen 1 (Kunemon's Bed) -> Kunemon
any Champion that waits long enough -> Vademon
